name: Vela 1.0: Open Foundation Routing Models
description: Compact models for routing, retrieval, safety and Omni.

paragraphs: A public playground for the Vela 1.0 model family, by vLLM Semantic Router. Results come from the selected model's pinned checkpoint on CPU. Exact built-in examples can reuse a prior successful inference, clearly marked as a cached example result. The interface includes fifteen interactive demos powered by fourteen model checkpoints from fourteen model repositories: classification, request-and-response safety judgements with user-defined categories, evidence-based hallucination highlights, PII highlights and redaction, content-risk thresholds, semantic similarity, dynamic prompt routing,…
